description: Example term list for docs/stale_check.py. A workspace keeps its own list at <workspace-root>/.incutec/stale_terms.json, or names one with --terms; that list is workspace record and does not belong in this repository. This example documents the format and carries only generic placeholder terms. A term is a heuristic: a hit means a file states a retired system as current authority, an old contact point, or leftover placeholder text, and needs a human look. Paths are matched as <repo>/<path-in-repo>, with "root" for the workspace root repository; an allowlist glob names a tree of historical evidence that is expected to keep the words.
